children: Flex Ltd. (FLEX) filed a Form 8K - Direct or off-Balance Sheet Financial Obligation - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on October 14, 2026.

As previously disclosed, on September 29, 2026, the Company entered into a Credit Agreement (the "Credit Agreement"), by and among the Company, as borrower, the lenders party thereto and Citibank, N.A., as administrative agent, which provides for a senior term loan credit facility in an aggregate committed amount of $3.3 billion (the "Credit Facility"). In connection with the consummation of the Transaction, on October 14, 2026, the Company borrowed $3.3 billion under the Credit Facility in a single advance to pay a portion of the Consideration and other fees and expenses related to the Transaction. The Credit Facility will mature on October 13, 2027, the date that is 364 days after the date on which it was funded. Loans under the Credit Agreement bear interest at a floating rate, which can be, at the Company's option, either (i) Term SOFR (as defined in the Credit Agreement) plus an applicable margin or (ii) the Base Rate (as defined in the Credit Agreement) plus an applicable margin, in each case, with such margin determined based on the Company's senior unsecured long-term debt ratings. The Company is required to prepay the loans under the Credit Facility upon the funding of a term loan facility to be entered into by Axiom in connection with the Spin-Off.

As described above, in connection with the consummation of the Transaction, on October 14, 2026, the Company borrowed $1.1 billion under the Bridge Credit Facility in a single advance to pay a portion of the Consideration and other fees and expenses related to the Transaction.
The information set forth in Item 1.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K is hereby incorporated by reference into this Item 2.03.

The foregoing description of the Credit Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the Credit Agreement, a copy of which was filed by the Company as Exhibit 10.01 to the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the SEC on October 2, 2026, and which is incorporated herein by reference.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/866374/000119312526421058/d147467d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/866374/000119312526421058/0001193125-26-421058-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
